sentences.cn: 我怎么才能出去？
sentences.en: How can I get out?

sentences.cn: 萨姆和博比开心地打着乒乓球。
sentences.en: Sam and Bobby are playing table tennis happily.

sentences.cn: 苏海正在给网友安娜写电子邮件。
sentences.en: Su Hai is writing an email to her e-friend Anna.

sentences.cn: 王兵是个好男孩。
sentences.en: Wang Bing is a good boy.

sentences.cn: 一头大狮子很强壮，一只小老鼠很弱小。
sentences.en: A large lion is strong, and a small mouse is weak.

sentences.cn: 老鼠从旁边走过，狮子用网把它罩住了。
sentences.en: The mouse walks by and the lion catches it in a net.

sentences.cn: 狮子咬那张网，可它的牙不够尖。
sentences.en: The lion bites the net, but its teeth are not sharp.

sentences.cn: 老鼠小声说：“总有一天我会帮你。”
sentences.en: The mouse says quietly, “I will help you some day.”

sentences.cn: 第二天，狮子大声呼救。
sentences.en: The next day the lion shouts loudly for help.

sentences.cn: 就在那时老鼠来了，很快就帮上了狮子。
sentences.en: Just then the mouse comes, and soon it helps the lion.

sentences.cn: 从那时起他们成了好朋友，大家都欢呼起来。
sentences.en: From then on they are good friends, and everyone cheers.

sentences.cn: 老鼠撞击那张网，弄出一个深洞。
sentences.en: The mouse hits the net and makes a deep hole.

sentences.cn: 狮子够不着老鼠，只好难过地很快走开了。
sentences.en: The lion cannot reach the mouse, so it sadly goes away quickly.

sentences.cn: 刘涛也是个好男孩。
sentences.en: Liu Tao is a good boy too.

sentences.cn: 可刘涛有一些坏习惯。
sentences.en: But Liu Tao has some bad habits.

sentences.cn: 王兵和刘涛是朋友。
sentences.en: Wang Bing and Liu Tao are friends.

sentences.cn: 王兵和刘涛有哪些习惯？
sentences.en: What habits do Wang Bing and Liu Tao have?

sentences.cn: 王兵有一些好习惯。
sentences.en: Wang Bing has some good habits.

sentences.cn: 他们在博比的卧室里。
sentences.en: They are in Bobby’s bedroom.

sentences.cn: 我从不迟到，总是把作业做完。
sentences.en: I am never late and I always finish my homework.

sentences.cn: 他的房间很整洁，不过昨晚他很困。
sentences.en: His room is tidy, but last night he was sleepy.

sentences.cn: 别走进那个房间，慢慢走。
sentences.en: Don’t go into the room, and walk slowly.

sentences.cn: 他跑得快，可球打得很差。
sentences.en: He runs fast but he plays badly.

sentences.cn: 迈克的饮食健康吗？
sentences.en: Does Mike have a healthy diet?

sentences.cn: 杨玲早饭常常吃很多面条。
sentences.en: Yang Ling often has a lot of noodles for breakfast.

sentences.cn: 杨玲的饮食健康吗？
sentences.en: Does Yang Ling have a healthy diet?

sentences.cn: 杨玲不吃很多甜食。
sentences.en: Yang Ling does not eat a lot of sweets.

sentences.cn: 妈妈，我可以喝点可乐吗？
sentences.en: Mum, can I have some cola?

sentences.cn: 你一次需要一点水和几个鸡蛋。
sentences.en: You need a little water and a few eggs at a time.

sentences.cn: 我是蒂娜。
sentences.en: This is Tina.

sentences.cn: 蒂娜，你可以坐公交车。
sentences.en: You can take the bus, Tina.

sentences.cn: 我们必须学习道路安全知识。
sentences.en: We must learn about road safety.

sentences.cn: 从斑马线过马路。
sentences.en: Cross the road at the zebra crossing.

sentences.cn: 走在人行道上，当心汽车。
sentences.en: Walk on the pavement and look out for cars.

sentences.cn: 遵守交通规则，保持安全。
sentences.en: Follow the traffic rule and stay safe.

sentences.cn: 等绿灯，安全地过马路。
sentences.en: Wait for the light and cross safely.

sentences.cn: 你能很容易地看见红灯。
sentences.en: You can easily see the red light.

sentences.cn: 这个星期天是儿童节。
sentences.en: It is Children’s Day this Sunday.

sentences.cn: 苏海要去买些零食和饮料。
sentences.en: Su Hai is going to buy some snacks and drinks.

sentences.cn: 这是星期天上午。
sentences.en: It is Sunday morning.

sentences.cn: 聚会在儿童节那天。
sentences.en: The party is on Children’s Day.

sentences.cn: 聚会在苏海家举行。
sentences.en: The party is at Su Hai’s home.

sentences.cn: 刘涛没有和朋友们一起去参加聚会。
sentences.en: Liu Tao does not go to the party with his friends.

sentences.cn: 去参加西式聚会时，你应该带一件礼物。
sentences.en: When you go to a Western party, you should take a gift.

sentences.cn: 聚会开始了，一个小丑拿着气球出现了。
sentences.en: The party begins, and a clown appears with a balloon.

sentences.cn: 他们演了一个节目，五点结束。
sentences.en: They put on a show, and it ends at five.

sentences.cn: 莉莉要为聚会做什么？
sentences.en: What’s Lily going to do for the party?

sentences.cn: 安迪要带什么去聚会？
sentences.en: What’s Andy going to bring to the party?

sentences.cn: 孩子们下周要学习关于澳大利亚的内容。
sentences.en: The children will learn about Australia next week.

sentences.cn: 在家里，刘涛正在读关于澳大利亚的内容。
sentences.en: At home, Liu Tao is reading about Australia.

sentences.cn: 在澳大利亚你会发现许多有趣的东西。
sentences.en: You will find many interesting things in Australia.

sentences.cn: 你也会喜欢悉尼的。
sentences.en: You will also like Sydney.

sentences.cn: 孩子们将学习关于澳大利亚的内容。
sentences.en: The children will learn about Australia.

sentences.cn: 刘涛在澳大利亚有一个网友。
sentences.en: Liu Tao has an e-friend in Australia.

sentences.cn: 杨玲要读一些关于澳大利亚的书。
sentences.en: Yang Ling will read books about Australia.

sentences.cn: 比利要给博比和萨姆做晚饭。
sentences.en: Billy will cook dinner for Bobby and Sam.

sentences.cn: 迈克，假期你要去哪儿？
sentences.en: Where will you go for the holiday, Mike?

sentences.cn: 你要坐飞机去北京吗？
sentences.en: Will you go to Beijing by plane?

sentences.cn: 苏海，暑假你要去哪儿？
sentences.en: Where will you go for the summer holiday, Su Hai?

sentences.cn: 你要去迪士尼乐园吗？
sentences.en: Will you go to Disneyland?

sentences.cn: 我和朋友们暑假会很忙。
sentences.en: My friends and I will be busy in the summer holiday.

sentences.cn: 博比，我们怎么去英国？
sentences.en: How will we get to the UK, Bobby?

sentences.cn: 欢迎来到我们的国家！
sentences.en: Welcome to our country!

sentences.cn: 你可以在这本杂志上了解澳大利亚。
sentences.en: You can find out about Australia in this magazine.

sentences.cn: 比如，袋鼠和考拉都来自澳大利亚。
sentences.en: A kangaroo and a koala are from Australia, for example.

sentences.cn: 运动爱好者喜欢澳式橄榄球，这项运动很刺激。
sentences.en: A sport-lover likes Australian football, and the game is exciting.

sentences.cn: 游客可以看到伦敦、牛津、大本钟、伦敦眼和塔桥。
sentences.en: Visitors can see London, Oxford, Big Ben, the London Eye and Tower Bridge.

sentences.cn: 我要在伦敦待一个月。
sentences.en: I will stay in London for a month.

sentences.cn: 萨姆，你觉得呢？
sentences.en: What do you think, Sam?

sentences.cn: 我要去北京看望姑姑和姑父。
sentences.en: I’ll visit my aunt and uncle in Beijing.

sentences.cn: 博比正在和萨姆谈他的旅行计划。
sentences.en: Bobby is talking about his travel plans with Sam.

sentences.cn: 暑假我回台北。
sentences.en: In the summer holiday I go back to Taipei.

sentences.cn: 你会在香港待多久？听起来很棒。
sentences.en: How long will you stay in Hong Kong? It sounds great.

sentences.cn: 我们去迪士尼乐园和海洋公园，拍了很多照片。
sentences.en: We visit Disneyland and Ocean Park, and take many photos.

sentences.cn: 一位旅行者想环游世界，看看不同的地方。
sentences.en: A traveller wants to travel around the world and see different places.

sentences.cn: 我要去北京。
sentences.en: I’ll go to Beijing.

sentences.cn: 他要去北京。
sentences.en: He’ll go to Beijing.

sentences.cn: 萨姆对博比的计划很兴奋。
sentences.en: Sam is excited about Bobby’s plans.

sentences.cn: 李老师正在问学生们的梦想。
sentences.en: Miss Li is asking the students about their dreams.

sentences.cn: 李老师正在写关于学生们梦想的内容。
sentences.en: Miss Li is writing about her students’ dreams.

sentences.cn: 将来我想当宇航员，驾驶宇宙飞船。
sentences.en: In the future I want to be an astronaut and fly a spaceship.

sentences.cn: 只要努力，我的梦想就会实现。
sentences.en: My dream will come true if I work hard.

sentences.cn: 足球运动员想参加世界杯。
sentences.en: A football player wants to play in the World Cup.

sentences.cn: 舞蹈家和钢琴演奏家都很在意音乐。
sentences.en: A dancer and a pianist care about music.

sentences.cn: 一位勇敢的科学家守护着这个世界。
sentences.en: A brave scientist takes care of the world.

sentences.cn: 艺术家喜欢画画。
sentences.en: An artist likes to paint.

sentences.cn: 我的牙疼。
sentences.en: My tooth hurts.
